gaps.explanation: Schedule is 212,573 above the statement. The governmental funds statement (p5, cash basis) prints Total disbursements 705,763 (General column; Bond column '-') and prints the Bond Fund 'Debt service (212,571)' under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES) (in JSON other_financing -209,403 = (212,571) + Grants and donations 3,168). The Bond Fund budget-and-actual schedule (p10) prints the same money among DISBURSEMENTS: Debt service - principal 167,900 + Debt service - interest 44,451 + Other 220 = 212,571 (detail, section expenditure). The General Fund combining schedule (p12) department lines add to 705,765 vs printed Total disbursements 705,763 (2 = the report's own rounding, see report_discrepancies). 705,765 + 212,571 = 918,336 = schedule total; 918,336 - 705,763 = 212,573. Every printed row is in detail[]; the statement and the schedule classify the Bond Fund debt service differently. No fix.

Schedule is 4,095 above the statement. JSON business-type receipts come from the accrual Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Change in Net Position - Proprietary Funds (p7): Utility sales Water 183,191 + Sewer 199,002 (Nursing Home '-') = 382,194 + Interest income 5,238 (Sewer) = 387,432. Detail already holds the proprietary funds' own printed schedule, Schedule of Receipts, Disbursements and Change in Fund Balance - Cash Basis - Budget and Actual - Proprietary Funds (p11, 'Actual (Budgetary Basis)'): Utility sales 386,289 + Interest income 5,238 = 391,527. The p7 fund-column rows cannot be added: the same money is already in the p11 lines (double count), and the p11 lines are printed schedule lines, not duplicates. 386,289 - 382,194 = 4,095 = cash collections vs accrual sales. No fix.

Schedule is 61,943 short. p7 (accrual): operating expense rows Water 149,825 + Sewer 131,427 (Total operating expenses printed 281,252; the Total-column rows add to 281,253), incl. Depreciation and amortization 68,090 + 79,250 = 147,340, + Interest expense 13,067 + 10,215 = 23,282; statement 304,535. p11 cash-basis schedule (in detail): Personnel expenses 74,286 + Operating expenses 57,876 + Debt service 110,430 = 242,592 (no depreciation; debt service as cash principal and interest). Adding the p7 fund columns would double count the p11 lines. 304,535 - 242,592 = 61,943 (basis difference, not a missing printed line). No fix.
